fact: The Access to Information Act was enacted on 20 July 2018 and is the law the Information Commission's November 2025 whitepaper reviews and proposes to amend.

The Information Commission, the oversight body under the Act, is reported to have been issuing orders, decisions and directives under Part VII s.63(1) since 2019, which information holders have ignored; no decision or figure of requests is given, so applied is not recorded.

Seychelles' Information Commission investigated an appeal under the Access to Information Act 2018 by Merleen Rassool against the Agriculture Department.
The Information Commission found the Agriculture Department in breach of sections 11(1), 12 and 21 of the Act and closed the case on 15 November 2024.
Seychelles' Information Commission issued a decision notice under the Access to Information Act 2018 in the appeal of Karen Domingue against the Seychelles Planning Authority.
The Information Commission found the Planning Authority non-compliant with sections 11 and 17 of the Act and ordered full access to the requested files within 5 days of its compliance letter.
